'''Anti-glare goggles''', or '''polarized goggles''',<ref name"FaDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> protected a being's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Rebel trooper/Legends|soldiers]] used such [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] as part of their [[Alliance Cold Weather Headgear|cold-weather headgear]] set.
